policy.A: applied physical events of the step: sum of event weights W over all real events of both collision stages
policy.B_r: bound of region r in the step: sum over carriers and stages of W n v sigma_bound dt (physical events)
policy.unbounded_regions: refuse the step iff region_support[r] > 0, unless the region index is in admitted_unbounded_regions
policy.region_support: number of positive-weight positive-density positive-time carrier-stage records with reachable support in region r; includes zero relative speed and zero X_r
policy.region_identity: regions are identified by index and name (blob strings section); a mismatch of blob_sha256 refuses the policy
